mapper.select: SELECT CPC.REG_CODE PRD_REGIST_CODE, COUNT(INVESTHOLD_SUB.INDENTIFY_MARK) holdCount, INVESTHOLD_SUB.HOLD_DATE, END_SUB.MDATE prdAclMDate, CP.ISSUING_STATUS prdIssueSts FROM INVESTHOLD_SUB LEFT JOIN END_SUB ON INVESTHOLD_SUB.PRODID = END_SUB.PROD_ID LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO CP ON INVESTHOLD_SUB.PRODID = CP.PROD_ID LEFT JOIN CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE CPC ON CP.PROD_ID = CPC.PRODID WHERE ((CP.ISSUING_STATUS != #{issuingSuccess,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR CP.ISSUING_STATUS IS NULL) OR (END_SUB.MDATE IS NOT NULL AND END_SUB.MDATE < INVESTHOLD_SUB.HOLD_DATE)) GROUP BY CPC.REG_CODE, INVESTHOLD_SUB.HOLD_DATE, END_SUB.MDATE, CP.ISSUING_STATUS

SELECT INVESTHOLD_SUB.PRODID, INVESTHOLD_SUB.INDENTIFY_MARK, INVESTHOLD_SUB.HOLD_DATE FROM INVESTHOLD_SUB LEFT JOIN END_SUB ON INVESTHOLD_SUB.PRODID = END_SUB.PROD_ID LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO CP ON INVESTHOLD_SUB.PRODID = CP.PROD_ID WHERE ((CP.ISSUING_STATUS != #{issuingSuccess,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR CP.ISSUING_STATUS IS NULL) OR (END_SUB.MDATE IS NOT NULL AND END_SUB.MDATE < INVESTHOLD_SUB.HOLD_DATE))
SELECT INVESTHOLD_SUB.PRODID, INVESTHOLD_SUB.INDENTIFY_MARK, INVESTHOLD_SUB.HOLD_DATE FROM INVESTHOLD_SUB
SELECT PROD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, SINGLE_TOTAL prdSingleTotal, LEGAL_TOTAL prdLegalTotal, UNLEGAL_TOTAL prdUnLegalTotal, VDATE prdVDate FROM OBJREC

,INVESTHOLD_SUB AS ( SELECT PROD_REGIST_CODE, SINGLE_TOTAL, LEGAL_TOTAL, UNLEGAL_TOTAL, VDATE, INDENTIFY_MARK, HOLD_DATE FROM ( SELECT A.PROD_REGIST_CODE, A.SINGLE_TOTAL, A.LEGAL_TOTAL, A.UNLEGAL_TOTAL, A.VDATE, B.INDENTIFY_MARK, B.HOLD_DATE, B.STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition BY A.PROD_REGIST_CODE, B.PRD_REGIST_CODE, B.INDENTIFY_MARK, B.HOLD_DATE ORDER BY B.UPDATE_TIME DESC) AS rowno FROM OBJREC A INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB B ON A.PROD_REGIST_CODE = B.PRD_REGIST_CODE AND STR_TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(B.HOLD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') = STR_TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') ) WHERE rowno = 1 AND STATUS != #{statusDel,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ,EQU_SUB AS( SELECT PROD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, SINGLE_TOTAL prdSingleTotal, LEGAL_TOTAL prdLegalTotal, UNLEGAL_TOTAL prdUnLegalTotal, VDATE prdVDate, HOLD_DATE holdDate, SUM(case when instr('${prdSingleTotalStr}', HOLDER_TYPE) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) investSingleTotal, SUM(case when instr('${prdLegalTotalStr}', HOLDER_TYPE) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) investLegalTotal, SUM(case when instr('${prdUnLegalTotalStr}', HOLDER_TYPE) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) investUnLegalTotal FROM ( SELECT INVESTHOLD_SUB.PROD_REGIST_CODE, INVESTHOLD_SUB.SINGLE_TOTAL, INVESTHOLD_SUB.LEGAL_TOTAL, INVESTHOLD_SUB.UNLEGAL_TOTAL, INVESTHOLD_SUB.VDATE, INVESTHOLD_SUB.INDENTIFY_MARK, INVESTHOLD_SUB.HOLD_DATE, CHB_EQU_SUB.STATUS, CHB_EQU_SUB.HOLDER_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition BY INVESTHOLD_SUB.PROD_REGIST_CODE, CHB_EQU_SUB.INDENTIFY_MARK ORDER BY CHB_EQU_SUB.UPDATE_TIME DESC) AS rowno FROM INVESTHOLD_SUB INNER JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB ON INVESTHOLD_SUB.INDENTIFY_MARK = CHB_EQU_SUB.INDENTIFY_MARK ) WHERE rowno = 1 AND STATUS != #{statusDel,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY PROD_REGIST_CODE, SINGLE_TOTAL, LEGAL_TOTAL, UNLEGAL_TOTAL, VDATE, HOLD_DATE ) SELECT EQU_SUB.prdRegistCode, EQU_SUB.prdSingleTotal, EQU_SUB.prdLegalTotal, EQU_SUB.prdUnLegalTotal, EQU_SUB.prdVDate, EQU_SUB.holdDate, EQU_SUB.investSingleTotal, EQU_SUB.investLegalTotal, EQU_SUB.investUnLegalTotal,
((case when EQU_SUB.prdSingleTotal != EQU_SUB.investSingleTotal then 1 else 0 end) + (case when EQU_SUB.prdLegalTotal != EQU_SUB.investLegalTotal then 1 else 0 end) + (case when EQU_SUB.prdUnLegalTotal != EQU_SUB.investUnLegalTotal then 1 else 0 end)) errRecTotal FROM EQU_SUB WHERE EQU_SUB.prdSingleTotal != EQU_SUB.investSingleTotal or EQU_SUB.prdLegalTotal != EQU_SUB.investLegalTotal or EQU_SUB.prdUnLegalTotal != EQU_SUB.investUnLegalTotal
